rca of the issue: Resolved in iteration_5. iteration_4 RCA: cod_verif declared Optional[str] in Pydantic but Postgres column is INTEGER -> asyncpg raised DataError on every UI POST (frontend sends '' for unfilled optionals and numeric string for filled cod_verif). Main agent fix: (1) cod_verif: Optional[int] in both SucursalCreate and SucursalUpdate; (2) @field_validator('*', mode='before') on both models converts isinstance(v,str) and v.strip()=='' to None - this both lets Pydantic coerce numeric string '123456' -> 123456 via standard int validation AND silences empty strings for any Optional field. Verified by 4 new pytest cases + 2 frontend E2E flows.
